raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Qwen3.5 MTP and Qwen3-VL vision checkpoints can contain serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 or mixed-precision auxiliary weights. The MTP `fc` was always an `nn.Linear`, which cannot allocate the packed weight and scale parameters, and the vision tower discarded the quantization config. Enabling the vision path also exposes its higher-dimensional activations to the W4A4 matrix kernel.

This change opts auxiliary modules into ModelOpt quantization only when their per-layer checkpoint metadata explicitly lists them. It also isolates draft config changes from the target model and allocates one full-attention MTP layer.

The design follows the config/scheme/backend separation described in [Quantization Modifications](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/15194). The concrete motivation is an internal minimal reproducer using a Qwen3.5/Qwen3-VL checkpoint with serialized ModelOpt metadata: the visual aliases were not selected, packed MTP `fc` metadata fell back to dense `Linear`, and a three-dimensional visual activation reached a two-dimensional-only NVFP4 GEMM. This PR documents the metadata contract and rejects incomplete auxiliary entries; no existing public issue describes this exact ModelOpt auxiliary-weight combination.

## Modifications

- Use `ReplicatedLinear` for ModelOpt MTP `fc` and unwrap its forward result. Checkpoints without explicit MTP metadata retain the existing BF16 draft behavior.
- Preserve flat and nested NVFP4 `quantized_layers` metadata and apply the model's weight-name mapper. Uniform FP4 treats auxiliary metadata as a whitelist, while respecting exclusions and keeping unlisted auxiliary layers in BF16.
- Match vision `model.visual`/`visual` and `qkv`/`qkv_proj` names for metadata and exclusions. Pass ModelOpt quantization to the vision tower only when it is explicitly listed.
- Preserve already mapped visual `qkv_proj` names when using the real Qwen3-VL substring mapper, avoiding `qkv_proj_proj`.
- Flatten W4A4 activations to a matrix and restore their leading dimensions after the GEMM, including noncontiguous vision inputs. Preserve the existing prequantized tuple path.
- Reject incomplete auxiliary fused-projection metadata and uniform per-expert auxiliary MoE metadata rather than allocating incompatible packed buffers. Uniform auxiliary MoE requires a whole fused-module entry; mixed-precision dispatch retains its existing behavior.

## Accuracy Tests

CPU regressions passed in a disposable ARM64 container on DGX Spark (Torch 2.13.0+cu130, Transformers 5.12.1, pytest 9.1.1). The tested snapshot was `0042e3d8d29ed3399123cc79e60e2349b589f783`; all changed production source and CPU test file SHA256 hashes match final HEAD `f22670dcca213a0718f3950943e0442971f3bb33`, which only adds the GPU regression file. Public source archives were mounted read-only, and no GPU devices were exposed.

| Suite | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_5_mtp_quant_config.py` | 13 passed |
| `test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_modelopt_nvfp4.py` | 18 passed; 26 subtests passed |
| `test/registered/unit/configs/test_model_config.py` | 12 passed; 8 subtests passed |

All three suites also pass direct CI-style `python testfile.py -f` execution (13, 18, and 12 tests). The tests exercise real packed MTP weight/scale allocation and loading, real BF16 linear forward behavior, draft config isolation, auxiliary metadata dispatch including the real Qwen3-VL name mapper, exclusions, fused metadata rejection, and vision activation shape restoration. Only the accelerator quantization/GEMM kernels are mocked for the CPU shape test. No failing assertions were skipped.

The final commit `f22670dcca213a0718f3950943e0442971f3bb33` passed the real GPU regression `test/registered/kernels/ops/quantization/test_modelopt_nvfp4_vision.py -f`: **1 test, no skips**, in 1.770 seconds on NVIDIA GB10 / SM121 (driver 580.173.02, Python 3.12.3, Torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, FlashInfer 0.6.18). It uses serialized ModelOpt NVFP4 W4A4 with the CUDA quantizer and explicit `flashinfer_cutlass` GEMM. The source archive is mounted read-only, and import paths confirm production modules come from this exact source.

The GPU test covers real packed weight/scale loading and postprocessing, contiguous/noncontiguous `[3, 2, 256]` activations matching the explicit 2D result exactly, bias, the prequantized tuple path, and an independent dequantized reference (rtol/atol 0.05). There are no accelerator mocks. The same final regression test against baseline `7ff3a112846a3fcc12a27bba09d644885a226e4d` passes the 2D/reference setup and fails the first ND input at `x_m, _ = x.shape` with `ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)`.

The coverage run passes **43 tests and 34 subtests**. Changed production-line coverage against pinned base `7ff3a112846a3fcc12a27bba09d644885a226e4d` is **87% (81 changed lines, 10 uncovered)**; `diff-cover --fail-under=60` exits 0. This CPU coverage uses the tested `0042e3d8` snapshot with the final-source file identity described above. Coverage tools were installed only in the disposable validation container.

The new CPU regressions also fail on that pinned pre-fix baseline: visual alias dispatch returns no NVFP4 configuration, quantized MTP `fc` remains a plain `Linear`, and draft depth remains 8 instead of 1. Full-model `/generate`, visual/MTP accuracy, and performance validation remain pending. Results from the previous release runtime are not used as validation for this branch, and this PR does not claim to resolve generation repetition.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Warmup-aware model speed tests have not run yet. GPU regression duration above is not a model performance measurement. This remains a draft until representative end-to-end validation is complete.

## Checklist

- [x] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes at final `f22670d`: all 30 applicable hooks pass, including all Rust formatting and Clippy hooks; no tracked files changed.
- [x] Add registered CPU and real GPU regression tests; GPU pre-fix sensitivity is verified.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- [x] Registered CPU test CLI execution passes.
- [x] Changed production-line coverage is 87%, exceeding the registered unit-test guide's 60% threshold; CPU pre-fix sensitivity is verified.
- [ ] Complete end-to-end GPU accuracy validation.
- [ ] Complete speed validation.

Feedback on the auxiliary metadata contract and whether to split the vision and MTP changes would be appreciated. Thank you for reviewing.

+"""Serialized NVFP4 vision linears preserve token order across leading dimensions.
+
+Before the ND activation fix, a [sequence, batch, hidden] input reaches the
+matrix-only quantization/GEMM path without flattening and cannot return the
+same result as its explicit matrix view. These tests use real FlashInfer
+kernels and checkpoint-format weights through the layer's weight loader.
+"""

+import unittest

+import torch

+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization import fp4_utils

+    ModelOptFp4Config,
+    ModelOptFp4LinearMethod,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import create_context, use_context
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.quant_ref_utils import (
+    break_fp4_bytes,
+    dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# The single-GPU small pool is Blackwell (5090); no model download is needed.
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=20, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+class TestModelOptNvfp4Vision(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            raise unittest.SkipTest(
+                "FlashInfer NVFP4 CUTLASS requires NVIDIA Blackwell"
+            )
+        if torch.cuda.get_device_capability() not in (
+            (10, 0),
+            (10, 3),
+            (12, 0),
+            (12, 1),
+        ):
+            raise unittest.SkipTest(
+                "FlashInfer NVFP4 CUTLASS regression targets SM100/103/120/121"
+            )
+
+    def _make_layer(self):
+        n, k = 160, 256
+        prefix = "model.visual.blocks.0.mlp.linear_fc1"
+        config = ModelOptFp4Config.from_config(
+            {
+                "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                "group_size": 16,
+                "ignore": [],
+                "packed_modules_mapping": {},
+                "quantized_layers": {prefix: {"quant_algo": "NVFP4"}},
+            }
+        )
+        with torch.device("cuda"):
+            layer = ReplicatedLinear(
+                input_size=k,
+                output_size=n,
+                bias=True,
+                params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                quant_config=config,
+                prefix=prefix,
+            )
+            rows = torch.arange(n)[:, None]
+            columns = torch.arange(k // 2)[None, :]
+            low = (rows + columns) % 16
+            high = (2 * rows + 3 * columns + 1) % 16
+            weight = (low | (high << 4)).to(torch.uint8)
+            scale = ((rows + torch.arange(k // 16)[None, :]) % 4 + 1).float() / 4
+            scale = scale.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            scale_2 = torch.tensor(0.125, dtype=torch.float32)
+            bias = torch.linspace(-0.25, 0.25, n, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            checkpoint = {
+                "weight": weight,
+                "weight_scale": scale,
+                "weight_scale_2": scale_2,
+                "input_scale": torch.tensor(0.002, dtype=torch.float32),
+                "bias": bias,
+            }
+            for name, loaded_weight in checkpoint.items():
+                parameter = getattr(layer, name)
+                parameter.weight_loader(parameter, loaded_weight)
+            self.assertIsInstance(layer.quant_method, ModelOptFp4LinearMethod)
+            self.assertEqual(layer.quant_method.quant_mode, "w4a4")
+            layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+        weight_reference = (
+            break_fp4_bytes(weight)
+            * scale.float().repeat_interleave(16, dim=-1)
+            * scale_2
+        )
+        return layer, weight_reference
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_nd_and_prequantized_inputs_match_matrix_and_dequantized_reference(self):
+        context = create_context(
+            ServerArgs(
+                model_path="dummy", fp4_gemm_runner_backend="flashinfer_cutlass"
+            ),
+            role="test",
+        )
+        previous_backend = fp4_utils.FP4_GEMM_RUNNER_BACKEND
+        with use_context(context):
+            try:
+                fp4_utils.initialize_fp4_gemm_config()
+                layer, weight_reference = self._make_layer()
+                generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7)
+                noncontiguous = (
+                    torch.randn(
+                        (2, 3, layer.input_size),
+                        device="cuda",
+                        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                        generator=generator,
+                    )
+                    / 10
+                ).transpose(0, 1)
+                self.assertFalse(noncontiguous.is_contiguous())
+                contiguous = noncontiguous.contiguous()
+                matrix = contiguous.reshape(-1, layer.input_size)
+                matrix_output, output_bias = layer(matrix)
+                self.assertIsNone(output_bias)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(matrix_output).all().item())
+
+                quantized = fp4_utils.fp4_quantize(matrix, layer.input_scale_inv)
+                activation_reference = dequantize_nvfp4_to_dtype(
+                    *quantized, layer.input_scale_inv, torch.float32
+                )
+                reference = (activation_reference @ weight_reference.T).to(
+                    torch.bfloat16
+                ) + layer.bias
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    matrix_output.float(), reference.float(), rtol=5e-2, atol=5e-2
+                )
+
+                expected = matrix_output.reshape(3, 2, layer.output_size)
+                for name, activation in (
+                    ("contiguous", contiguous),
+                    ("noncontiguous", noncontiguous),
+                ):
+                    with self.subTest(layout=name):
+                        output, output_bias = layer(activation)
+                        self.assertIsNone(output_bias)
+                        self.assertEqual(output.shape, (3, 2, layer.output_size))
+                        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(output).all().item())
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(output, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+                layer._accepts_prequantized_fp4 = True
+                prequantized_output, output_bias = layer(quantized)
+                self.assertIsNone(output_bias)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    prequantized_output, matrix_output, rtol=0, atol=0
+                )
+            finally:
+                fp4_utils.FP4_GEMM_RUNNER_BACKEND = previous_backend
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
